item.title: Greenmont improvement projects on tap for Morgantown city officials
item.description: The City of Morgantown is moving forward with a revitalization plan for the Greenmont neighborhood that includes a new bridge, a pump track, and a skate park.

item.title: MedEd program to be offered at Buckhannon-Upshur High School this fall
item.description: WVU Medicine St. Joseph’s Hospital is partnering with Buckhannon-Upshur High School to offer students a new opportunity to excel in healthcare pre and post-graduation.

item.title: Local experts advise skipping hard and sour candies this Valentine's Day
item.description: Sarah Vismans, a registered dental hygienist at Veltri Family Dental in Bridgeport, gave her thoughts on what sweet treats may be best for your teeth this Valentine's Day.

item.title: Deputies capture wanted man hiding in rural West Virginia
item.description: The Upshur County Sheriff's Office announced Thursday that it has located and arrested a man who was wanted for several crimes.

item.title: Grave robbing, arson and a disappearance: The story of Jerry Miller
item.description: Two days later, on Aug. 19, police found Miller, who had changed his hair color, hiding in a Morgantown tavern in the rafters. He was initially arrested on fraud charges but was held on a $50,000 bond as the grave-robbing investigation continued.

item.title: Upshur County tracking group helps find US Representative's lost dog
item.description: A local business helped reunite a family visiting West Virginia with their lost dog, Suki, after she was lost during a family trip.

item.title: Tunnelton Quik Stop owner says he's lost nearly $800,000 due to road work
item.description: Since January 2025, road work has been taking place outside of the Tunnelton Quik Stop, and according to Owner Dave Biggins, the work has resulted in a significant downturn in business.

item.title: 1 transported; 4 animals rescued after trailer catches fire in Marion County
item.description: One person was taken to the hospital early Thursday morning after a trailer caught fire just outside of Fairmont.

item.title: Man admits to placing card skimmer in Clarksburg grocery store
item.description: A man has admitted to placing credit card skimming devices in several retailers across north central West Virginia, including Clarksburg, the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) announced Thursday.

item.title: Fairmont man charged after allegedly kidnapping 1 victim, stabbing another while stealing dog
item.description: A man has been charged after allegedly kidnapping one victim and stabbing another while stealing a dog in Marion County.
